sources.label: 🧩 Android patches for Viber, BeReal, MovieBox, Proton Mail, Proton VPN, TeraBox
sources.author: hxreborn
patch_list: Adds an Unread shortcut to the app icon's long-press menu that opens unread mail from all accounts and folders. Launchers with four shortcut slots show it in place of View calendar.
Fixes signing in with Microsoft accounts.
Signs in to Google accounts through GmsCore instead of Google Play Services. Requires GmsCore.
Hides Copilot chat, summaries, scheduling and writing help on all accounts, regardless of the Copilot setting in Outlook.
Leaves messages unread after opening them, or flagging or moving them from the reading pane.
Opens .oft template attachments as new drafts without a Microsoft 365 subscription.
Removes sponsored messages from Focused and Other.
Adds long-press selection to search results for marking, moving or deleting several messages at once. Works in the Mail tab of search.
